title: IncidentTriagePoCRow
description: One historical incident for batch eval (JSONL: one object per line).

mode.description: offline = prompt-only replay; live_replay = re-fire in Grafana when possible.

initial_prompt.description: Single-shot investigation prompt (no back-and-forth). Align with stackgen-sre buildInvestigationPrompt shape.

golden_root_cause.description: Published RCA root cause — human rubric reference.

golden_rca_full.description: Full published RCA text — used for bootstrap-memory import and human review.

labels.description: Optional alert labels (service, namespace, cluster, alertname).

ootb_expected.description: SE pre-label before eval — updated after v1 scorecard.

evaluation_id.description: Optional batch tag stamped into source_metadata.evaluation_id.

approved_by.description: Human who curated golden RCA for bootstrap provenance.

source.description: Provenance: postmortem link, ticket id, or curated_import.
